reasoning: The question asks whether the US 5-year forward inflation expectation rate (T5YIFR) will increase between March 15 and March 22, 2026. The evidence shows recent inflation trends: January 2026 CPI at 2.4% (down from 2.7%), with expectations for modest inflation around 2.5% in early 2026. University of Michigan 5-year inflation expectations were at 3.3% in February 2026, down from 3.4%. The evidence suggests inflation expectations have been gradually declining or stabilizing. The T5YIFR is derived from Treasury yield spreads and reflects market-based inflation expectations. Given the recent downward trend in inflation expectations and stable inflation data, a week-to-week increase seems unlikely. However, short-term market movements are inherently unpredictable, and the question involves only a 7-day window with no specific catalyst mentioned.
